headline: Bangladesh Garment Wage Board Sets December Start
deck: Employers and workers agreed a revised garment-wage structure beginning Dec. 1; workers will receive it in January salary payments.
body: Bangladesh’s garment-sector wage board agreed with employer and worker representatives that a revised minimum-wage structure will take effect on Dec. 1 and be paid with January salaries, the Daily Sun reported. [E2]
AFP reported that workers had sought a December wage increase so they could receive their revised salaries in January. [E1]
The agreement was announced after the eighth minimum-wage board’s first meeting in Dhaka, Ajker Patrika reported. [E3]
